info.title: Rewards Loyalty Sync
info.description: Enables a secure way to sync a customers loyalty status information with Barclays

400.description: The request could not be understood by the server due to malformed syntax. The client SHOULD NOT repeat the request without modifications.

401.description: The user could not be authenticated for this request.

403.description: The user is not permitted to access the requested operation and it cannot be completed.

404.description: Server has not found a resource with that URI. This may be temporary and permanent condition. This status code is commonly used when the server does not wish to reveal exactly why the request has been refused, or when no other response is applicable.

503.description: Temporary maintenance of service, try again later. The implication is that this is a temporary condition which will be alleviated after some delay. Note: The existence of the 503 status code does not imply that a server will use it when becoming overloaded. Servers may simply refuse the connection.

TierUpdateStatus.description: Contains tier code update success/failure status for each account.

externalAccountId.description: Common card account identifier agreed between GAP and Barclays, unique per card. Generated at Barclays during card apply/conversion process and provided to GAP to be stored for further communication with Barclays.

status.description: Indicates whether tier update request specific to EAID has been processed successfully or declined due to any of the multiple errors mentioned in Error Codes sheet.

ErrorType.description: Message details - additional operation execution information.

code.description: Machine readable, unique code of the message related to particular case within operation execution.

detail.description: Provides additional low-level details about the error to assist with troubleshooting. Not for displaying purposes.

id.description: Generated message identifier for particular request, helping to locate server logs.

title.description: Short description of the error. Not for displaying purposes.
title.example: The authorization credentials required for this request are invalid.

ErrorType.title: ErrorType

tierUpdateStatusList.description: List of tierUpdateStatus objects per unique EAID under one loyalty program, which contains information about the status of tier update request processed at Barclays.

errors.description: Contains one or more error messages and is mutually exclusive with the data item. This will not be returned in success scenarios.

ErrorDetails.description: Contains error information if the requested upgrade/downgrade is declined.

code.description: Error code describing the type of HTTP error.

detail.description: A brief message describing the reason for failure to assist with troubleshooting.

TierUpdateRequest.description: Contains account information, current and new tier codes etc.
TierUpdateRequest.title: TierUpdateRequest
